highlights: Both share the same non-negotiable (non-smoking household), so there is no dealbreaker. They also match on location (Fenway/Mission Hill), room type (private room), drinking (socially), pet attitude (love pets, have none) and hybrid WFH schedules.

Both negotiated constructively. Daily vegetarian cooking, late calls to India and a 68-72°F thermostat were accepted without friction.
concerns: Sleep schedule mismatch: Meera is a night owl (asleep after midnight, wakes 8-10am) and Priya wakes at 6-8am and needs quiet a few times a week on WFH days. Late-night noise, especially on weeknights, is still an open item.

Social energy gap: Meera lists matching social energy as a priority and wants weekly guests, while Priya hosts about monthly. The compromise of two gatherings a month plus 2-3 friends in Meera's room may leave Meera feeling restricted over time, and Priya may find even this more than she is used to.

Logistics mismatch: Meera moves in within a month on a 6-month lease, while Priya moves in 1-3 months out and wants a 1-year lease. The conversation never addressed this. Their cleanliness ratings also differ (3 vs 4), and 'tidy' is not yet defined in writing.
middle_ground: Put the quiet-hour terms in writing: common areas quiet by 11:30pm, weeknights fully quiet, and room hangouts of 2-3 friends with the door closed and voices low. Add a shared calendar of Priya's quiet/WFH days.

Align the lease and move-in timing: pick a move-in date around the 1-month mark, then start with a 6-month lease with an option to renew to 12 months, or sign a 12-month lease with a sublet/replacement clause. Finalize the 'tidy' checklist before move-in and review the guest arrangement after 2-3 months.
analysis.recommendation_summary: Priya and Meera are aligned on the non-negotiable (non-smoking), location, money handling and chore structure, and both showed real willingness to compromise. The main risks are the sleep-schedule and social-energy differences, plus the unresolved lease-length and move-in timing gap. A written agreement on quiet hours, guest limits and lease terms would make this a workable match.
